🎬 Uncharted (2022)

Uncharted follows Nathan Drake, a clever and adventurous young bartender who is recruited by experienced treasure hunter Victor “Sully” Sullivan to recover a legendary fortune lost centuries ago during Ferdinand Magellan’s expedition. Motivated by the possibility of discovering what happened to his missing older brother, Sam, Nathan joins Sully on a dangerous adventure across the globe. Their mission becomes increasingly complicated when they encounter Santiago Moncada, a wealthy and ruthless treasure seeker who believes the fortune rightfully belongs to his family. Alongside the mysterious Chloe Frazer, Nathan and Sully must decipher ancient clues, solve complicated puzzles, escape deadly traps, and overcome unexpected betrayals. As the adventure unfolds, Nathan discovers that finding the treasure requires more than intelligence and courage—it also requires knowing whom to trust. Starring Tom Holland, Mark Wahlberg, Sophia Ali, and Antonio Banderas, the film delivers thrilling action, spectacular adventures, entertaining humor, and exciting storytelling about loyalty, friendship, ambition, and discovery.

🎭 Genre: Action • Adventure • Treasure Hunting

⭐ IMDb: 6.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 56m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Ruben Fleischer

✍️ Writers: Rafe Lee Judkins, Art Marcum & Matt Holloway

🎮 Based On: The popular Uncharted video game franchise developed by Naughty Dog.

💰 Box Office: Approximately $407 million worldwide.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Uncharted is a 2022 American action adventure film based on the video game franchise developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Directed by Ruben Fleischer from a screenplay by Rafe Lee Judkins, Art Marcum, and Matt Holloway, it stars Tom Holland as Nathan Drake and Mark Wahlberg as Victor Sullivan, with Sophia Ali, Tati Gabrielle (in her film debut appearance), and Antonio Banderas starring in supporting roles. In the film, Drake is recruited by Sullivan in a race against corrupt billionaire Santiago Moncada (Banderas) and mercenary leader Jo Braddock (Gabrielle) to locate the fabled treasure of the Magellan expedition.
